author: tylerpieper
name: PostsAsCode
short: Sync Discord channels and threads from Markdown and image files in a Git repository.
description: Manage static Discord documentation channels and threads (rules, getting-started guides, FAQs) as code in a Git repository. Maps channels or threads to repository folders containing ordered Markdown (.md) and image files, and syncs via edit-in-place, delete-and-repost, or full channel reset.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users. It stores per-guild Git repository settings, channel/thread mappings, and IDs and content hashes of messages posted by the bot.
